en.headline: Three domestic helpers warned for using employers’ data to obtain loans
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner found the helpers breached the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance by supplying names, addresses and phone numbers without consent, leading to debt-collector harassment.
body: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data has issued warning letters to three foreign domestic helpers after they used their employers’ personal information without consent to apply for loans from financial institutions.

Privacy Commissioner Ada Chung Lai-ling said on Tuesday that in each case the helpers provided employers’ names, residential addresses and telephone numbers to lenders. After the helpers defaulted, the employers received repeated calls, messages or overdue notices, and in one instance a threat that debt collectors would visit the home.

One helper had applied to four different institutions. All three helpers admitted the disclosures and were subsequently dismissed by their employers. The Commissioner found they had contravened Data Protection Principle 3(1) of the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, which requires prescribed consent for use of personal data for a new purpose.

The office reminded helpers that employer data obtained for work purposes must not be used for loan applications without express prior consent, and urged financial institutions to remain vigilant. A pamphlet in Chinese, English, Tagalog and Bahasa Indonesia has been issued to reinforce the message. The Commissioner also published separate guidance on protecting personal data when using agentic artificial-intelligence systems.

zh.headline: 三外傭擅用僱主資料借貸 私隱公署發警告信
zh.dek: 私隱專員裁定三名外籍家庭傭工未經同意向財務機構提供僱主姓名、地址及電話，違反私隱條例，僱主其後遭追債滋擾。
body: 個人資料私隱專員公署周二公布，已向三名外籍家庭傭工發出警告信，指她們未經僱主同意，擅自使用僱主個人資料向財務機構申請貸款。
私隱專員鍾麗玲表示，三宗個案中，外傭均向財務機構提供僱主的姓名、住址及電話號碼。其後外傭拖欠還款，僱主收到多次來電、訊息或逾期通知書，其中一宗更威脅會派人上門追討。
其中一名外傭曾向四間財務機構申請貸款。三名外傭均承認有關披露，其後被僱主解僱。公署裁定她們違反《個人資料（私隱）條例》保障資料第3(1)原則，即未經訂明同意不得將個人資料用於新目的。
公署提醒外傭，因工作取得的僱主資料不得在未獲明示同意下用於借貸，並呼籲財務機構提高警覺。公署已印製中、英、菲律賓文及印尼文小冊子加強宣傳，同日亦發布有關使用代理式人工智能時保障個人資料私隱的指引。
